passages.provision_quote: The State Board of Elections shall provide an ID-ONLY provisional ballot envelope that requires no follow-up action by the registrar or electoral board other than matching submitted identification documents from the voter for the electoral board to make a determination on whether to count the ballot.
passages.note: Chapter 725 limits poll ID to photo ID ("any other photo identification", passport, licence, photo student/employee cards), states no sworn-statement path, and makes a voter without ID vote provisionally with the ballot counted only on submitted ID: rung 4 polls branch.

rows.reasoning: O'Quinn voted Yea (65-34) on SB 1256 (2013), a single-subject law that accepts only photo identification at the polls, offers no sworn statement, and sends a voter without ID to an ID-ONLY provisional ballot counted only on 'matching submitted identification documents', which is the polls branch of 'Require ID before a ballot counts: photo ID at the polls'. His later Yea votes on HB 46 (2022) and HB 1444 (2023) and his No on HB 19 (2020) point the same way but separate no rungs, since those bills' ID lists carry no photo condition.
